chunks: He said: Abu Ghalib Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Zurari informed me, from Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Zakariyya, from Muhammad ibn Sinan and Yunus ibn Yaqoob, from Abdul A'la ibn A'yan who said: I heard Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, saying:
"Our first one is a guide to our last one, and our last one is a confirmer of our first one. The tradition among us is the same. Indeed, when Allah the Exalted ordains a decree, He implements it."

All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds. And may Allah bless our master Muhammad the Prophet and his family and grant them abundant peace. Al-Shaykh al-Mufid Abu Abdillah Muhammad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Nu'man — may Allah perpetuate his capabilities — narrated to us on Monday, the end of Shawwal, in the year four hundred and four.

key_terms.حُكْم: decree — Allah's ordained ruling that is invariably implemented
key_terms.دَلِيل: guide/proof — the first Imam serves as evidence and direction toward the last
key_terms.سُنَّة: tradition/practice — the consistent divine methodology among the Imams
key_terms.مُصَدِّق: confirmer/authenticator — the last Imam validates the teaching of the first

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq say about the continuity and unity of the Imams?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) articulates the theological principle of Imamate continuity: the first Imam guides to the last, the last confirms the first, and the divine tradition (sunnah) is constant among all Imams. This teaching was delivered to the original Shia community who recognized the chain of divinely-appointed Imams, affirming that the authority and knowledge of each Imam is equal and complementary, and that God's will once decreed is invariably executed.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 5. He said: Abu Ghalib Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Zurari reported to me from Abdullah ibn Ja’far al-Himyari, from al-Hasan ibn ‘Ali from Zakariyya, from Muhammad ibn Sinan and Yunus ibn Yaqoob, from Abdul A’ala ibn A’ayan who said: I heard Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, say:
"Our first one is the ushering guide to our next one, and our next one is the conformer of the first one. And among us, the tradition is constant. Surely, when Allah ordains, He implements it."

All Praise be to Allah, the Lord of all Universe and Allah bless our master Muhammad, the Prophet and his progeny and send peace upon them. Al-Shaikh al-Mufid Abu Abdillah Muhammad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Nu’man - may Allah perpetuate his capabilities - narrated to us on Monday, the end of Shawaal, in the year four hundred and four.
